programme_name: Deep phylogenetic inheritance of lineage-specific trait-memory rankings

relationship_to_prior_work.role: Post-outcome exploratory mechanism-structure test only. It cannot reclassify the prospective BIEN results or the prospective AusTraits replication.

question: Are lineage-specific conservative-to-labile trait rankings themselves inherited across deep plant-family phylogeny, or are they phylogenetically mosaic?

population.effect_contract: pre-frozen positive-only cleaned Stage B effects

family_phylogeny.representative_rule: full GBOTB family crown, identical to family_context_phylogeny_representative_amendment_v0_1_3
family_phylogeny.distance: patristic distance between family crown representatives on the unmodified backbone

rank_profile_dissimilarity.for_each_family_pair: Among shared traits, compare every unordered pair of traits. A pair is discordant if family A and family B disagree about which trait has larger memory-loss rho. Tied comparisons are excluded from the denominator.
rank_profile_dissimilarity.statistic: rank_disagreement = discordant trait-pair comparisons / all non-tied shared trait-pair comparisons
rank_profile_dissimilarity.equivalence: For no ties, rank_disagreement = (1 - Kendall tau)/2.
rank_profile_dissimilarity.range: 0 identical relative ordering; 1 completely reversed ordering

primary_association.response: rank_disagreement on cleaned log S3 rho
primary_association.statistic: Spearman rho across eligible unordered family pairs
primary_association.expected_direction_if_deep_inheritance: positive: more distant families have more discordant trait-memory rankings
primary_association.permutation_scheme: Permute complete observed family rank profiles, including their trait-coverage pattern, among the fixed 45 family-tree positions. Recompute eligible pairwise rank disagreement after each permutation. This preserves every profile, the sparse family-by-trait graph carried by each profile, and the fixed family distance matrix.
primary_association.p_value: one-sided for the preregistered positive direction: (1 + count(rho_null >= rho_observed))/(B + 1)

mandatory_sensitivities: Repeat the identical test with cleaned log prune-only rho.
Repeat S3 and prune-only using minimum_shared_traits = 3.
Report cleaned raw S3 and prune-only associations descriptively under the same statistic.
Report slope-free binned summaries of median disagreement by family-distance quartile for interpretation only.

interpretation.positive_on_both_log_axes: Lineage-specific trait-memory ranking retains detectable deep phylogenetic continuity: related families tend to reorder traits similarly.
interpretation.S3_only: Possible deep-phylogeny tendency is tree-treatment sensitive; do not call inherited ranking architecture robust.
interpretation.weak_or_null_on_both_log_axes: The lineage-specific ranking is not detectably organized along deep family phylogeny at this resolution; describe it as a phylogenetically mosaic reconstruction rather than a smoothly inherited higher-level hierarchy.
interpretation.negative: Unexpected: closer families have more different rankings. Report as exploratory and do not invent a mechanism.

hard_nonclaims: A null association does not prove rank profiles are evolutionarily random.
No causal ecological driver is identified.
Do not use this analysis to select families, traits, trait scale, or tree treatment.
Do not replace the prospective AusTraits replication with this exploratory BIEN analysis.
Do not interpret memory-loss rho as evolutionary rate.
